content: शीतल {%a.%} [शीतं लाति ला-क, शीतमस्त्यस्य लच्-वा] .²1 .³({%a%}) Cool, cold, chill, frigid; अतिशीतलमप्यम्भः किं भिनत्ति न भूभृतः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .³({%b%}) Cool, bearable; महदपि परदुःखं शीतलं सम्यगाहुः <ls>V. 4. 13</ls>. .²2 Not exciting, calm, gentle. .{@-लः@} .²1 The moon. .²2 A kind of camphor. .²3 Turpentine. .²4 The Champaka tree. .²5 A kind of religious observance (observed upon the sunʼs entering the sign {%Aries%}). .{@-लम्@} .²1 Cold, coolness. .²2 The cold season. .²3 Benzoin. .²4 White sandal, or sandal in general. .²5 A pearl. .²6 Green sulphate of iron. .²7 A lotus. .²8 The root called वीरण <ab>q. v.</ab>
